correlations.statement: endpoint-compliance-agent version 7.4.2-27 (CHG-88104) was installed on intg-prod-a1 at 2026-02-22T00:00:00+00:00, 8 days before onset.
supporting_evidence: CHG-88104 is the only change record in the pre-onset window; it was implemented 8 days before the first memory exhaustion alert (P-4100, 2026-03-02T03:17:00+00:00).
The packages_installed registry confirms endpoint-compliance-agent 7.4.2-27 installed at 2026-02-22T00:00:00+00:00 as the newest package on the host.
The registry note states: 'The newest package on the host predates onset by 8 days.'
self_updating_agents_not_reflected=true: the agent may have self-updated between installation and onset without a corresponding package record.

The process snapshot at 2026-03-17T19:00:00+00:00 shows setroubleshootd (audit-analysis-server) consuming 99.7% CPU, started at 2026-03-02T06:00:00+00:00 — coinciding with the close of the first memory exhaustion event (P-4100 closed 2026-03-02T05:57:00+00:00).
Memory usage stepped up from a flat ~24.2 GiB baseline to a rising sawtooth pattern beginning at 2026-03-02T00:00:00+00:00, consistent with a new persistent process activating.
correlations.falsifying_test: Confirm whether the endpoint-compliance-agent was active and consuming memory on the host between 2026-02-22 and 2026-03-01; if memory was flat during that period and the agent was idle, the 8-day gap weakens the temporal proximity of this correlation.

correlations.statement: setroubleshootd (audit-analysis-server 3.3.22-2.el8, pid 3501048) was observed running at 99.7% CPU from 2026-03-02T06:00:00+00:00, 0 days after onset, consuming 622,770,257 bytes of resident memory.
correlations.offset_from_onset: 0 days after onset (process start coincides with close of first exhaustion event)
supporting_evidence: Process snapshot shows setroubleshootd started at 2026-03-02T06:00:00+00:00 with 79h 58m cumulative CPU time as of 2026-03-17T19:00:00+00:00.
audit-analysis-server package installed 2023-03-13 — not a new installation; activation event is not captured in the package registry.
SELinux is in enforcing mode on this host; setroubleshootd is the SELinux AVC denial analysis daemon and would activate in response to new AVC denials.
CHG-88104 (endpoint-compliance-agent) was deployed 8 days before onset; a new agent could generate novel SELinux AVC denials that trigger setroubleshootd activation.
The registry note states: 'The audit analysis daemon has been installed for 3 years. Its activation is not an installation event.' — confirming the activation is not reflected as a package change.
correlations.falsifying_test: Inspect /var/log/audit/audit.log for AVC denial volume starting 2026-03-02; if no spike in AVC denials is present, the setroubleshootd activation is unrelated to SELinux policy enforcement against the new agent.

correlations.statement: kernel version 4.18.0 was installed at 2025-08-22T00:00:00+00:00, 192 days before onset.
supporting_evidence: Kernel 4.18.0 is the installed kernel per packages_installed registry.
No change record exists for this kernel installation in the changes_list window queried.
correlations.falsifying_test: If memory behaviour was stable for the entire 192-day period between kernel installation and onset, this correlation has no temporal relevance.

registry_caveats: self_updating_agents_not_reflected: true — the packages_installed response carries this caveat verbatim. Agents that self-update do not produce new package records; the current version of endpoint-compliance-agent running on the host may differ from 7.4.2-27 without any registry evidence.

The registry note states: 'The audit analysis daemon has been installed for 3 years. Its activation is not an installation event.' Activation of setroubleshootd on 2026-03-02 is not captured in any registry source.
deployments_list returned no pipeline-sourced deployments; the OS package manager and change registry are the declared sources of truth for this host.
No pipeline deployments means any application-layer change (e.g. integration-service.jar update) delivered outside the pipeline would be invisible to this registry.
